Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: JG Chemicals Limited reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, driven by robust demand across end-user applications resulting in all-time highs for revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted progress on capacity expansions including the Dahej greenfield project and Naidupeta brownfield expansion, both targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27. The company is also focusing on new product developments like LabPure zinc oxide, JG-ZRA, and recycled rubber (JG TUR) to enhance product mix and drive margins. Overall, the management remains optimistic about sustaining volume growth and improving margins through higher value-added products and cost optimization initiatives. J.G.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% with higher value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories including passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, and three-wheelers.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Encouraging traction is observed in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong demand and volume growth across all end user applications during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA reported Q1 FY27 volume growth across major vehicle categories including PV, 2W, CV, and 3W.
demand_outlook.quote: As Per ATMA, Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories — PV +26.6% YoY, 2W +16.58% YoY, CV +16.48% YoY, 3W +11.32% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand from OEMs coupled with replacement demand will aid future growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from the OEM’s coupled with strong replacement demand will aid future growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Many large OEMs are expanding production capacities in India for domestic and export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing a trend of many large OEM’s expanding their production capacities in India to cater to both the domestic and export markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are increasing capacities on priority to cater to domestic demand and capture new export markets, with an estimated capex of INR 25,000 crore announced.
demand_outlook.quote: As per recent ATMA reports, an estimated Capex of about INR 25,000 crore has been announced by tyre majors. Approx. 25% of the tyres produced in India are now exported so Indian tyre majors are increasing capacities on priority to cater to the strong domestic demand as well as capture new export markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry was extremely robust through the fourth quarter and continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand momentum across tire industry was extremely robust right through the fourth quarter and the same momentum has continued in the current quarter as well as we speak.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for zinc sulphate is seeing green shoots as farmers accept the new pricing normal.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we are seeing slight demand, green shoots coming off in the last couple of months, and we expect that with the new pricing range which is being set now, this will become the new standard normal and demand would come back to its old older days.

capex_expansion.claim: The Gujarat project is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, taking combined capacity beyond 115,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej project and Naidupeta brownfield are both expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: The company has undertaken brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support future demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside Dahej, we have also undertaken certain brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support the future demand.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a margin of 8.27%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Structurally, management maintains that EBITDA margins range between 10% to 12%, with potential for higher margins from value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see, we have always maintained that in our industry, the EBITDA margins would be in the range of 10% to 12%, and going forward, we will have higher margins because of higher value-added products.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental costs including higher freight, energy, and ancillary costs have been transparently passed on to all customers.
margins_costs.quote: In line with our long-standing pricing philosophy, all of these incremental costs, including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs, have been transparently passed on to all our customers with effect from 1st April 2026 itself.

margins_costs.claim: Higher value-added products would help increase blended EBITDA margins to the 13% to 14% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see our current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range, and as we've mentioned before, higher value-added products would help increase the blended margins to the 13% to 14% range.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed manufacturing capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh commands close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels stand in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: Indian tire majors have announced approximately INR25,000 crores of capex, and roughly 25% of tires produced in India are exported.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the tire industry capex is concerned, Indian tire majors are expanding their capacities to cater to this demand, with approximately INR25,000 crores of capex already announced by leading tire manufacturers, and to this, roughly today 25% of the tires produced in India are being exported.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization rates for zinc oxide are in the late 70s.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current utilization rates are in the late 70s, and we can easily take this up to the 86% to 87% range as required.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai as a wholly-owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited, a material subsidiary of JG Chemicals, and consequently a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of JG Chemicals Limited.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 1 of the solar power generation project at Naidupeta was commissioned in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In keeping with this sustainability agenda, I am pleased to inform you that we have commissioned Phase 1 of our solar power generation project at Naidupeta in FY26, which has progressively been ramping up our share of renewable energy.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted the recent West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the recent West Asia crisis, the Indian tyre majors are expanding their capacities to cater to the OEM demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global supply chain disruptions were noted during the recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months.

risks_headwinds.claim: During March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and huge delays in shipments from Europe due to geopolitical conflicts.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the month of March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and also there were huge delays in shipments from Europe.

risks_headwinds.claim: March was characterized by a sudden spike in energy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Moreover, March was also characterized by a sudden spike in energy prices.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to continue the strong performance momentum going forward.
management_commitments.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

management_commitments.claim: Once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream, combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum by 2029.
management_commitments.quote: With the Gujarat project being commissioned during the current financial year, and once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum, a scale which is perhaps matched today globally by only a few players.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to completely debottleneck the Naidupeta facility by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: So, this is a gradual process which is going on, and we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
